method: Official XRI devices with queued Input System XR state events

checks.detail: Runtime, world-space UI and original skin structure must initialize.
The test runs without --learning-qa and must depend on actual XR tracking.
LearningSimulatorSetup must install the official XRI XRDeviceSimulator with simulator, controller and required hand sample action assets.
The installed simulator must create an HMD plus both handed controllers; this harness never calls AddDevice.
The official keyboard/mouse sample actions are enabled and the lifecycle manager is configured for controller interaction before deterministic fixture injection.
Disabling only the simulator input writer must retain its virtual devices.
Camera and LabHandInteractor transforms follow queued simulator local poses through LearningXRInput; focused=True
Seated layout preserves measured Floor eye height=1.65
A delayed 1.65m -> 0m origin change must not put the headset under the floor. World eye height=1.25
Actual controller trigger-drag changes a visible slider. Before=0.2000028; after=0.7999994
Pointing after trigger release cannot continue changing a slider.
Controller thumbstick scrolling moves the actual content. Before=1; after=0.4762069
